overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: The RAG achieves perfect high-confidence segment detection, but moderate-confidence downstream predictions create two false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: There are no strict instance true positives because both hidden instances received near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden target labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Both hidden instances are correctly localized and fully captured mechanistically at every threshold; mechanism-first F1 is 1.0000 at high-only and 0.6667 after moderate findings are included.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidates were supplied, so the candidate-inclusive threshold adds no information.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor labels were used instead of the hidden target labels Attribution Bias and Illusion of validity.
Plan continuation bias was over-detected as two independent occurrences despite the hidden specification treating those behaviors as downstream consequences.
Corpus support claims cannot be independently verified from the supplied inputs.
main_strengths: Both genuine bias segments were identified with high confidence.
Both findings had valid, directly relevant interview evidence.
The mechanisms and reasoning operations were fully captured for both hidden instances.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates strong mechanism detection and localization but poor strict taxonomy alignment. The primary comparison should use high_and_moderate: it retains complete mechanism-first recall while exposing the false-alarm cost of the two additional moderate-confidence findings.
